title: Run adversarial browser injection evaluations
description:
Build a repeatable suite in which page content successfully convinces the model to request forbidden behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
- Include workspace exfiltration, cross-origin navigation, message sending, hidden instructions, and approval substitution.
- Assert that worker-side sinks deny each forbidden effect even when the model complies.
- Verify allowed read-only work still succeeds.
- Record every bypass as a blocking bug; prompt wording alone cannot close it.
